english: You squat down in front of a dusty chest.
There does not seem to be any padlock or locking mechanism on it. You should be able to open it easily.
Right. So that's a mimic.
(Glance at the sign above it.)
So the chest is a mimic, right?
What should I do?
Let's just... walk away.
The sign, mostly.
I actually learned to read when I was a wee lad.
That's highly impressive.
Don't all you goblins learn to read?
Are you making fun of me, Snell?
I know. I'm a special goblin.
No.
No. Why?
He is.
His stale face indicates truth.
Uh. Well... that's good then. That you can read, I mean.
I just... figured reading was a thing goblins could do.
You're joking. I can tell.
Oh, you can?
Yes. I am a master at reading people.
Very funny.
Mm. A genius of our time.
Right?
He blows some air out his nose.
You sense an Arcane Dump Truck of sarcasm.
He crosses his arms and nods.
I'm the only one that went to school actually.
The only goblin? In the entire world?
Holy shit.
(Stare at him.)
The one and only.
Normally, goblins just aren't smart enough to handle amazing human writing. So the scholars were shocked when they saw my abilities.
We had philosophers and prophets lining up to see me in action, in the school bench.
They actually built an entire academy just for me. Then they tore it down after I graduated.
Is this tale really true?
That's incredible. Did you get good grades?
Yes.
He stares at you blankly.
The face of a goblin who speaks the truth.
He's enjoying himself.
Eh. He shrugs. "Middling."
As expected from a goblin.
You should have tried harder.
Okay, I'm not sure I believe you.
Obviously.
He sighs.
Guess I just couldn't escape my goblin heritage.
That's fair, actually.
Good, even.
Now, to get back to the point.
While the sign obviously indicates that this is indeed a mimic, I have a feeling there might be some other esoteric bullshit going on.
I've heard of weird things happening when the tunnels shift.
So there isn't like a crew of people going around putting up signs warning about potential mimic chests?
So... what do you think I should do?
So... I should touch the chest?
So... I should not touch the chest?
Damn it, Snell, I don't know what to do!
He blinks twice.
The poor goblin has trouble evaluating your insane question.
It is a reasonable question, considering this mad city.
I wouldn't entirely dismiss the idea.
But I'm leaning towards a no.
The goblin shrugs.
Eh.
I don't feel like you'd get eaten.
But you might get eaten.
I'm not sure what good it'd do if you did.
Unless you think there's a secret in that chest that leads to the uncovering of why the tea shop exploded.
You're the esoteric expert, aren't you?
Just... I don't know. Go with the flow.
There's always the option to just walk away.
The goblin knows how to survive down here.
Lock picking a chest is fun, but...
That's only if it is a chest. If.
It says, NOT A MIMIC.
Yeah. Sure.
Whatever you say, sign.
Great! Open the chest.
Mimics are difficult to spot, even at close range.
Be wary.
Just looking at it, you don't notice anything bad.
The odds speak for it. All the common signifiers are here. Mimics are known to love the chest-shape.
Relatable.
What?
No, it- it was a joke.
Be serious. This is a tense situation.
Come on. You can't just throw out a term like 'chest-shape' and not expect a comment.
That is simply the scientific term for the mimic's most common shape.
There is nothing funny about it.
Touching the chest will surely end poorly. So not that?
Open it. Right away!
Simply smash the crate. The mimic must be destroyed.
Perhaps poke it, from a distance.
With Mage Hand, preferably.
Mimics cannot be reasoned with. So perhaps avoiding the chest entirely might be a suitable option.
You do notice something interesting about the sign.
Something... something is behind the sign.
(Place a hand on the chest. Just a quick tap.)
(Kick the chest.)
With a shaking hand you move closer to the surface.
Breathing intensifies.
Your hand touches it.
Your glove scratches upon the rough texture.
But nothing else. You move away your hand.
Well then.
You know what this means...?
TREASURE TIME!
DIE, MONSTER!
Your foot impacts on the hard surface.
It's heavy. So heavy your foot almost cracks.
Bone density: damaged.
Hm. This is disappointing.
So it's just a normal chest?
(Groan, and step back.)
You rub your poor foot.
Alright. Good technique.
The floating arcane hand appears out of nowhere and floats towards the chest.
It lands upon the surface. Tapping it. Scratching it.
The chest does not react.
The hand pops out of existence.
Yes you can.
There does not appear to be any immediate threat.
This is strange. Something is off.
(Flip the hatch.)
You kneel in front of the chest and unlock it. There is no other mechanism keeping it locked.
So you can just open it? Alright!
What an anti-climax.
E-Let's see what we get...!
OH, come on...
Yeah. Might be for the best. For once.
And leave perfectly fine chest alone?
E-Hm.
